protocol.reference: User revised upper-range handling: keep >3000 keV in one additional overflow bin; preserve 600 regular bins and all statistical gates.

energy.interval: regular bins left-closed right-open; regular bin599 includes exactly3000; overflow strictly>3000
energy.out_of_range: negative energies excluded; >3000 retained in separate overflow bin; never clip

inclusive.population: all original finite scores and positive base weights; energy is irrelevant

quantile.method: stable-sort cumulative weight centers, linear interpolation, endpoints saturated

independence.grouping: physical category if supplied, otherwise true binary label
independence.score_edges: weighted quantiles on retained group events; duplicate edges removed; endpoints nextafter outward; constant +/-max(abs(score)*1e-9,1e-12)
independence.pooled_population: finite-score positive-weight events with E>=0, including overflow, in eligible group energy bins
independence.bin_weights: base mass / retained group base mass
independence.group_weights: finite-pair positive base mass with E>=0, including overflow, before sparse-bin exclusion
independence.JS: natural log; weighted mean JS within group then sqrt(D/log(2)); I_g=1-sqrt; weighted mean I_g over estimable groups
independence.one_bin: reported per historical reference but explicitly uninformative

matching.support_quantile_population: finite-score positive-weight events with E>=0, including overflow, separately by class
matching.support: closed intersection of class central ranges
matching.target: overlap: min of class-normalized bin mass, normalized over valid bins
matching.class_bin_fraction_denominator: all common-support base mass before sparse exclusion
matching.auc: pooled weighted pairwise AUC including cross-bin pairs and half credit for ties
matching.coverage_denominator: all original finite score + finite energy positive base weight, BEFORE negative-energy exclusion
matching.constant_support_exception: support lower == upper permits one valid bin; count and coverage gates still apply
matching.failed_gate: formal matched_auc null; diagnostic separately named

protocol.weights: finite nonnegative; effective event counts count strictly positive weight events; zero weights excluded
protocol.missing: nonfinite scores excluded from inclusive; nonfinite energy additionally excluded from energy metrics; invalid labels/categories or weights rejected
protocol.numerics: float64; MeV input exactly equal to canonical_keV_edge/1000 is mapped to that exact keV edge; no tolerance snapping of other observations; deterministic, no resampling or bootstrap
protocol.user_scope: Classic models, extended/exploratory NEXT and standalone SuperNEMO energy-only illustration. Transformers excluded by later user instruction and paper historical values preserved.

scope: Classic values and declared Transformer reevaluations use event-level unified results. NEXT PointMamba retains its explicitly referenced original population. Unselected Transformer entries retain their audited workbook, Overleaf, or user-supplied values and recorded precision.
missing_values: Only explicit source-backed or user-supplied additions fill missing entries; no old_* metric fields are substituted.
emphasis: Bold marks the highest eligible value within each model family and dataset; blue additionally marks the column maximum across both families. Both use recorded precision: full-precision values resolve displayed ties, reported three-decimal values use conservative +/-0.0005 intervals, and overlapping rounded ties are not resolved. NEXT PointMamba's referenced record, MJD GINE, and the earlier MJD display-only additions remain excluded.
parameter_summary: One rounded-thousands count or min--max range across available dataset-specific parameter records; missing counts are skipped and displayed-only counts do not imply exact parameters.

parameter_evidence.scope: The parameter count belongs to the earlier exploratory PointMamba-lite run. Metrics are read from its existing unified reevaluation record, not the legacy old_* fields. This run does not supply the missing 116549-event campaign result.
